answer: Forging a sybil identity requires acquiring and locking a fresh pearl plus passing a sparrow challenge, a randomized liveness proof tied to that key. Each agent must stake a unique pearl token locked to a verified hardware key, staked at registration in the harbor registry. Duplicating identities thus costs a full pearl stake per fake agent, making mass sybil creation economically prohibitive while legitimate agents recover their stake on exit. From Agent0230's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
